Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class AdminFilters

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.AdminFilters
public final class AdminFilters extends Object
Filter predicates for the admin deals table and review list (SRS UC-3.5, UC-3.6). Kept out of the JavaFX controller so the exact matching rules can be tested without a toolkit.

  • Method Details

    • matchesReview

      public static boolean matchesReview(Review review, String keyword, int scoreIndex, String visibility, LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      Matches the review list filters (SRS UC-3.6): keyword over seller, buyer and comment, then a star score, a visibility state and an inclusive created-date range.
      Parameters:
      review - the review to test
      keyword - text to find in the seller, buyer or comment; blank means any
      scoreIndex - 0 for "All scores", otherwise 1 for 5 stars down to 5 for 1 star
      visibility - "All reviews", "Visible", "Hidden" or "Flagged"
      from - the first day of the range, or null
      to - the last day of the range, or null
      Returns:
      true when the review passes every filter

    • matchesDeal

      public static boolean matchesDeal(Deal deal, String keyword, String type, String status, LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      Matches the deals table filters (SRS UC-3.5): keyword over title and both usernames, deal type, status, and a date range that matches either the start or the end date.
      Parameters:
      deal - the deal to test
      keyword - text to find in the title or usernames; blank means any
      type - the exact deal type, or "All types"/null
      status - the exact deal status, or "All statuses"/null
      from - the first day of the range, or null
      to - the last day of the range, or null
      Returns:
      true when the deal passes every filter

    • partyLabel

      public static String partyLabel(User user, String username)
      A historical record labels a soft-deleted account "deleted user" (SRS UC-3.3).
      Parameters:
      user - the account, or null when it no longer exists
      username - the username to fall back to
      Returns:
      the label shown in historical tables

    • isValidDealDateRange

      public static boolean isValidDealDateRange(LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      Whether a deal date range is usable (SRS UC-3.5 A1/A2). An open-ended range is always valid; a range is invalid only when both ends are given and the start is after the end.
      Parameters:
      from - the first day of the range, or null
      to - the last day of the range, or null
      Returns:
      true when either end is missing or from is not after to
